descriptor.description:
Declare what this connector covers, how it is sourced, and what it does NOT cover.

Call this before telling a user that the law "does not contain" something, and whenever
a search comes back empty: the absence may be a gap in this connector rather than in the
law. Every gap carries a fallback saying where to look instead.

Returns:
    ``Coverage`` with families, an as-of note, and a non-empty list of known gaps.
descriptor.name: hu_coverage

outputSchema.description: What this connector covers, how it is sourced, and what it does not cover.

as_of_note.description: States what the dates mean, and what they do not promise.

items.description: One data family this connector exposes.

captured_at.description: Date this family was last captured (ISO). None when queried live.

live.description: True when queried live instead of from a snapshot.

source.description: Official source the data comes from.

tool.description: Tool or tools that reach this family.

known_gaps.description: Never empty. An empty list would mean 'not checked', not 'no gaps'.

items.description: A known, named hole in this connector's coverage - plus the way around it.

family.description: Which family the gap belongs to.

missing.description: What is NOT available through this connector.

descriptor.description:
Find the ELI issuer code of a local government (settlement, county or Budapest district).

Searches NJT's /eli/kshkodok table, accent- and case-insensitively, best match first.
Use the returned `code` (e.g. ``"735584"`` for Debrecen) with `hu_get_local_decree` and
`hu_read_local_decree` when a name is ambiguous.

name.description:
(part of) the name, e.g. ``"Debrecen"``, ``"Hajdu-Bihar"``, ``"Budapest XI"``,
or a numeric code to look up its name.

descriptor.name: hu_find_municipality

dataset_note.default: Nemzeti Jogszabalytar (NJT) is Hungary's official, free-to-use national legislation database, maintained by MKIFK (Magyar Kozlonykiado es Igazsagugyi Forditokozpont Zrt.) at njt.jog.gov.hu. Hungary publishes a genuine, documented national ELI (European Legislation Identifier) URI scheme since 2023 (see /eli/urisemak). Each ELI URI resolves (HTTP 302) to a partially server-rendered HTML page. Large acts may include deferred statutory or annex blocks; hu_get_text reconstructs them via NJT internal AJAX requests. There is no documented public REST/JSON search API; the search/browse UI is an AngularJS SPA that requires a session and JavaScript; documents must be addressed by a known ELI (type + year + serial, and an issuer code for non-Act types).

items.description: One issuer of municipal decrees from /eli/kshkodok (settlement, county or district).

descriptor.description:
Fetch metadata for any Hungarian legislation by its ELI (type + year + issuer + serial).

Use this for anything other than Acts (torveny) - government decrees, ministerial decrees,
etc. Use `hu_list_doc_types` for valid `doc_type` codes and `hu_list_issuers` for valid

descriptor.description:
Fetch metadata for a municipal decree (onkormanyzati rendelet) by its ELI.

ELI: ``/eli/OR/{year}/{issuer code}/{serial}[/{date}]``. Example: Debrecen's local building
regulation, 47/2020. (XII. 28.) onkormanyzati rendelet, is
``municipality="Debrecen", year="2020", serial="47"``.

date.description:
optional ``YYYY-MM-DD`` for the version in force that day, or ``"kozlony"``
for the version as published; omit for the version in force now.

municipality.description:
the issuing local government's name (e.g. ``"Ebes"``) or its numeric
code from `hu_find_municipality`. An ambiguous name is rejected with candidates.

serial.description: the decree's number within that year.

descriptor.name: hu_get_local_decree

outputSchema.description: A Hungarian piece of legislation resolved via its ELI URI.

descriptor.description:
Fetch complete legislation HTML, including NJT's deferred blocks.

The result can be very large (the Civil Code is about 3 MB of HTML). Check
`byte_size`: if your client truncates tool results, the text you see is not the
whole law, so do not conclude that a section is absent from what you received.

For Acts (torveny), pass `doc_type="TV"` and omit `issuer`. For anything else, pass the
`issuer` code (case-sensitive - use `hu_list_issuers`).

doc_type.description: NJT type code, e.g. ``"TV"`` (torveny / Act) or ``"R"`` (rendelet / decree).

issuer.description: NJT issuer code, case-sensitive (required for everything except `"TV"`).

serial.description: the document's serial number within that year.

descriptor.name: hu_get_text

outputSchema.description: Result of ``hu_get_text`` - the full document HTML/text of one act.

descriptor.description:
Read a municipal decree's complete plain text, one page at a time, with search.

The whole decree is loaded (including NJT's lazy-loaded sections and annexes), converted
to plain legal text, and returned from `start` for up to `max_chars` characters. Continue
with `start=next_start` until `next_start` is null; `complete` is true only when one page
holds the whole text. With `search` (case- and accent-insensitive), `matches` lists every
hit's offset and snippet - read from a hit's `start` to see the provision in context.
Annexes published only as files (e.g. plan sheets of a building regulation) appear as
``[PDF: url]`` in the text and in `attachments`.

date.description: optional ``YYYY-MM-DD`` (version in force that day) or ``"kozlony"``.

search.description: optional phrase to locate, e.g. ``"Lke-J/19"`` or ``"telepulesi foepitesz"``.

serial.description: the decree's number within that year.

start.description: character offset to read from (0 = beginning).

descriptor.name: hu_read_local_decree

outputSchema.description: One page of a document's plain legal text (footnotes and page chrome removed).

items.description: An annex NJT publishes only as an attached file (e.g. a plan sheet).

descriptor.description:
Read national legislation's complete plain text, one page at a time, with search.

Same addressing as `hu_get_text` (Acts: ``doc_type="TV"``, no issuer), but returns plain
legal text in pages instead of megabytes of HTML, so long codes (Btk., Ptk.) can be read
in full. Continue with `start=next_start` until `next_start` is null. With `search`,
`matches` gives each hit's offset and snippet.

date.description: optional ``YYYY-MM-DD`` (version in force that day) or ``"kozlony"``.

issuer.description: NJT issuer code, case-sensitive (required except for ``"TV"``).

serial.description: the document's serial number within that year.

start.description: character offset to read from (0 = beginning).
